thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Severity: P1 - ap-southeast3 GPU pool exhausted; autoscaler stalled on quota deny. Queue length ~4200, enqueue rate +300/s. Runbook: https://runbook/internal/scaleup-quota

sre-liz: acknowledged, taking. I'll gather logs and triage.

oncall-jess: I'm oncall, taking handoff. what's the observable customer impact?

support-ana: multiple customers reporting 502/503s in ap-southeast3 generation endpoints. Top customer C-Omega seeing ~30% error rate. sample payload: 

support-ana: ```{
  "code": "POOL_EXHAUSTED",
  "message": "No available GPUs - scaleup denied: QUOTA_EXCEEDED"
}```

eng-aaron: Confirmed in infra: GCP returning 403 QUOTA_EXCEEDED on attach attempts. Autoscaler backoff reached max_retries. Log snippet: 

eng-aaron: ```autoscaler.go: requestAttach() -> response=403, body={"error":{"code":403,"message":"Quota 'CP-GPU' exceeded for project"}}
retries=5, backoff=120s```

ops-mike: Is this a per-project regional quota or org-level? can someone check Cloud Console quotas?

eng-aaron: Project-level for ap-southeast3. current=240, limit=240. No warm pool capacity. Submitting quota increase request now.

eng-ml-raj: Mitigation idea: route non-SLA / free-tier requests to redwood-small-q4 temporarily to reduce GPU pressure. Also consider enabling quantized variant for burst traffic.

sre-liz: good plan. oncall-jess, can you flip routing for non-sla traffic and enable CPU fallback for background jobs?

oncall-jess: Applying route override now. Command -> 

oncall-jess: ```sh
redwoodctl routes patch --selector "tier!=sla" --set model=redwood-small-q4 --reason "quota mitigation ap-southeast3"
```

oncall-jess: Enabling CPU fallback for low-priority batch: 

oncall-jess: ```sh
redwoodctl jobs update --priority low --fallback cpu
```

ops-mike: Quota increase submitted (GCP case #123456789). Console shows ETA 2-6 hours. Also requested temporary increase via partner channel.

support-ana: After the route override we saw error rates drop from 30% -> ~12% for affected customers. Queue still high but decreasing.

sre-liz: monitoring dashboard: queue length 4200 -> 1800 over 3 minutes. Keep mitigations for at least 30m.

eng-aaron: Spinning up warm pool in eu-west1 and us-west2 for cross-region routing; warmup time ~6-10m. Pushing cross-region routing rule after pools ready.

oncall-jess: I'll post updates every 10m. If the quota isn't lifted in 30m, escalate to SRE lead @mike-lead to decide on permanent traffic shifts or customer compensations.

support-ana: status page update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4876543210 - customers notified.

sre-liz: summary: root cause = GCP regional GPU quota hit preventing autoscaler attachments; mitigations = route non-SLA to smaller model, enable CPU fallback for low-priority, create cross-region warm pools, request quota uplift. Impact = degraded generation endpoints in ap-southeast3, major customer C-Omega partially impacted. Next actions = monitor queue, confirm quota uplift, prepare postmortem.

eng-ml-raj: if uplift delayed, recommend applying temporary rate-limits for free-tier and prioritize paid/SLA traffic to protect critical customers.

oncall-jess: creating incident stub and assigning owners: https://confluence.internal/incidents/4876543210

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status changed to 'mitigated' at 4876543265 - queue reduced and customer errors decreased. Keep incident open until quota uplift confirmed.

sre-liz: I'll stay on until quota confirmed. tagging: @eng-aaron @ops-mike @support-ana @eng-ml-raj for follow-ups.

support-ana: continuing customer comms, will update slack when C-Omega response improves.

oncall-jess: handover note: next oncall in 30m unless clear. :thumbsup:
